verdict.rationale: Modal documents on-demand H100, A100 and A10G GPUs that can be attached to any sandbox, and the Sandbox API signature exposes a `gpu` parameter. A community builder also reports building GPU-native runners on Modal Sandboxes. missing for 10: in-depth first-party guide on configuring GPU types or counts for sandboxes, hands-on corroboration that explicitly confirms GPU attachment works in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach GPUs to sandboxed workloads

citations.quote: H100s, A100s, A10Gs available on demand. Attach to any sandbox, scale to thousands of concurrent runs, pay by the second with no reserved capacity.
was looking for a long time for gpu-native scalable and highly available runners, decided to build it myself on modal.
